display_fil:
Lumang poster; halo-halong form.
Alikabok; walang label; harang sa daan.
Walang responsable o petsa ng pagsusuri.
display_en:
Old poster; mixed forms.
Dust; no labels; blocked walkway.
No owner or review date.
narration_fil: Sinusuri ni BHW Tess ang kathang-isip na mesa. May lumang poster, halo-halong blangkong form at alikabok. Walang label sa lalagyan. May kahon sa daan. Walang nakatalagang tagasuri o petsa ng pagbalik. Kailangan ng kaayusan na magpapatuloy matapos ang isang paglilinis.
narration_en: BHW Tess inspects a simulated desk. There is an old poster, mixed blank forms and dust. Containers have no labels. A box blocks the walkway. No checker or review date is assigned. The team needs order that lasts beyond one cleaning session.

display_fil:
Sort: tukuyin ang hindi kailangan.
Systematize: ayusin ayon sa gamit.
Sweep: panatilihing malinis.
Standardize: iisang label at checklist.
display_en:
Sort: identify unneeded items.
Systematize: arrange by use.
Sweep: maintain cleanliness.
Standardize: shared labels and checklist.
narration_fil: Sort: tukuyin ang hindi kailangan at humingi ng pahintulot bago alisin. Systematize: ayusin ang gamit ayon sa paggamit. Sweep: panatilihing malinis ayon sa nakatalagang paraan. Standardize: magkasundo sa label, ayos at checklist. Sa mesa, suriin ang poster, forms, alikabok at lalagyan.
narration_en: Sort: identify unneeded items and seek authorization before removal. Systematize: arrange items according to use. Sweep: maintain cleanliness using the assigned procedure. Standardize: agree on labels, arrangement and a checklist. At the desk, inspect the poster, forms, dust and containers.

options.fil: Ayusin ang forms ayon sa gamit.
Maghintay ng utos bago gawin ang sariling tungkulin.

options.fil: Gumawa ng magkakaibang label araw-araw upang laging bago.
options.en: Make different labels daily so they are always new.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Inaayos ang kailangang gamit ayon sa paggamit. 2: Salungat ito sa self-discipline at hindi pag-aayos ng gamit. 3: Kailangan ng napagkasunduang standard, hindi pabago-bagong label.
check.feedback_en: 1: Needed items are arranged according to use. 2: This conflicts with self-discipline and does not arrange supplies. 3: A shared standard is needed, not changing labels.

narration_fil: Piliin muna ang sagot. Pagkatapos, basahin ang paliwanag sa bawat pagpipilian.
narration_en: Choose an answer first. Then read the explanation for each option.

display_fil:
Safety: ligtas na daanan.
Self-discipline: gawin ang tungkulin.
Sustain: ulitin at suriin ang routine.
Tess at staff: balikan sa Biyernes.
display_en:
Safety: a safe walkway.
Self-discipline: carry out responsibilities.
Sustain: repeat and review the routine.
Tess and staff: review on Friday.
narration_fil: Safety: iulat ang kahong nakaharang at ipaayos ang daan. Self-discipline: gampanan ang nakatalagang pagsusuri nang hindi laging inuutusan. Sustain: ulitin at balikan ang routine. Napagkasunduan ni Tess at staff ang araw-araw na checklist at pagsusuri sa Biyernes. Kumpleto ang pitong kategorya; hindi lang pagwawalis.
narration_en: Safety: report the blocking box and arrange a clear walkway. Self-discipline: carry out assigned checks without repeated reminders. Sustain: repeat and review the routine. Tess and staff agree on a daily checklist and a Friday review. All seven categories matter, not just sweeping.

display_fil:
Ligtas na props lamang sa practice.
Walang pagtatapon nang walang pahintulot.
Iulat ang matutulis o kontaminadong bagay.
display_en:
Use safe props only for practice.
No disposal without authorization.
Report sharps or contaminated items.
narration_fil: Blangkong papel at ligtas na props lamang ang gamitin sa practice. Huwag magtapon ng rekord, gamot o kagamitan nang walang awtorisasyon. Huwag humawak ng matutulis o kontaminadong bagay bilang bahagi ng gawaing ito. Iulat ang panganib sa nakatalagang staff at sundin ang lokal na pamamaraan.
narration_en: Use blank paper and safe props in practice. Do not discard records, medicines or equipment without authorization. Do not handle sharps or contaminated items as part of this activity. Report hazards to the assigned staff and follow the local procedure.

check.prompt_fil: Nalinis na ang mesa. Ano ang makatutulong upang magpatuloy ang 7S?
check.prompt_en: The desk is clean. What helps 7S continue?

options.fil: Alisin ang checklist para wala nang susunod na gawain.
options.en: Remove the checklist so there are no further tasks.

options.fil: Itakda ang tao, routine at review.
options.en: Assign an owner, routine and review.

options.fil: Sabihing tapos na ang lahat dahil isang beses nang nalinis.
options.en: Declare everything finished because it was cleaned once.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Nawawala ang gabay sa pagpapanatili. 2: May pananagutan at pagbalik sa resulta, hindi minsanang paglilinis. 3: Hindi nito sinusuri kung napapanatili ang pitong kategorya.
check.feedback_en: 1: The guide for maintaining the work is lost. 2: This provides responsibility and follow-up beyond one cleaning session. 3: This does not check whether the seven categories are maintained.

narration_fil: Balikan ang kuwento. Piliin ang angkop na susunod na hakbang.
narration_en: Return to the story. Choose an appropriate next step.

display_fil:
Pitong kategorya; hindi lang pagwawalis.
Sa Lunes: suriin ang simulated na mesa.
Isang pagbabago + tao + petsa + ebidensiya.
display_en:
Seven categories, not only sweeping.
On Monday: inspect the simulated desk.
One change + owner + date + evidence.
narration_fil: May checklist, responsable at petsa ng pagbalik ang grupo ni Tess. Sa Lunes, gamitin ang pitong hanay ng job aid sa simulated na mesa. Itala ang isang pagbabago at kung paano malalamang nagawa ito. Salita: sustain — tuluy-tuloy na pagpapanatili at pagsusuri ng napagkasunduang gawain.
narration_en: Tess’s group has a checklist, owner and review date. On Monday, use the seven-row job aid at a simulated desk. Record one improvement and how to tell whether it happened. Word: sustain — maintaining and reviewing the agreed routine over time.
